prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic, wide-angle shot set inside a spacious, industrial warehouse with high ceilings and metal shelving in the background, softly illuminated by diffused, cool-toned overhead lighting. In the foreground, a young boy stands confidently, centered in the frame, wearing a bright green sports bib over a dark polo shirt. His expression is serious and determined, and he holds his hand out in front of him, fingers pinched together in a gesture of focus or challenge. Behind him, slightly out of focus, stand five adult male soccer players in matching black and yellow striped jerseys, also wearing green training bibs. They stand in a loose formation, arms crossed or at their sides, exuding strength and solidarity as they look forward with stoic, supportive expressions. The color palette features muted industrial grays and metallics, contrasted by the vivid green of the bibs and the yellow stripes of the jerseys. The composition uses shallow depth of field to draw attention to the boy, with the background and adult figures softly blurred, creating a sense of depth and cinematic intensity. The overall mood is one of anticipation, teamwork, and determination, reminiscent of a dramatic sports film or commercial.
